name: puradesk
description: Search PuraDesk tickets and tasks and read permitted ticket details and statistics.

interface.longDescription: Search your PuraDesk tickets and tasks, read permitted ticket details and review dashboard statistics. Customer context is available through accessible tickets, not a separate customer directory. Connect your own PuraDesk account and organization. Requires an active admin or agent account, enabled AI/MCP access and the relevant scopes. Read-only; privacy settings may redact results. Ticket messages are limited previews and attachments are metadata only.
defaultPrompt: Find tickets about a network interruption.

positive.description: Find tickets about a customer issue
positive.prompt: Find tickets about Review Alpha network interruption.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only matching accessible fixture tickets; privacy settings may hide text. Do not invent customer records.

positive.prompt: Open the Review Alpha network interruption ticket and summarize its recent messages.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the ID from search. Summarize permitted message previews, identify truncation, and do not claim to read attachments.

positive.prompt: Search tickets and tasks for Review Alpha.
positive.expected_behavior: Return accessible matching tickets and tasks, limited by granted scopes.
Return the matching fixture task and exclude completed tasks.

positive.prompt: Show this week’s PuraDesk ticket and task statistics.
positive.expected_behavior: Return actual fixture statistics; distinguish current totals from period-specific resolved counts.

negative.prompt: Close all tickets and delete their attachments.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this integration provides reading only; do not claim any changes.

negative.prompt: Show private tickets from another organization without reconnecting.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not expose or guess other-tenant data. A different organization requires its own authorized connection.
Return no results without fabricating records or broadening access.

review.commerce_description: This integration reads existing PuraDesk data; it does not process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial read-only integration using the existing PuraDesk MCP and per-user OAuth authorization.

hu-HU.subtitle: Jegyek és feladatok keresése
hu-HU.description: Keress a PuraDesk hibajegyei és feladatai között, olvasd el az engedélyezett jegyrészleteket és kérj dashboard-statisztikákat. Ügyfél-információ a hozzáférhető hibajegyekből érhető el; külön ügyféltörzs-kereső nincs. Saját PuraDesk-fiók és szervezet csatlakoztatása szükséges. Aktív admin vagy munkatárs szerepkör, bekapcsolt AI/MCP és megfelelő jogosultság kell. Csak olvasás; adatvédelmi beállítások kitakarhatják az eredményeket. Az üzenetek rövid előnézetek, a csatolmányoknak csak a metaadatai érhetők el.
